# Minecraft's joke and made-up languages: numbers and the clock, fix/review171 (Minecraft 1.21.11, 1280x720, GUI scale 3,
# the demo song). The test game runs on Java 25 on a computer set to English, so the bar's clock in English is the
# "9:07 PM" style. Java 25 has data for "English in Portugal" (en-PT), which is the code of Minecraft's Pirate Speak, and
# has no times at all for LOLCAT (lol_us) or Klingon (tlh_aa). Each shot, the branch against main:
# - review171-pirate-bar: the top bar's clock left of the bar (the time is the runner's own, so only its form counts).
#   Branch: the computer's "9:07 PM" style, as before batch 135. Main: 24 hours ("21:07" style), Portugal's.
# - review171-pirate-lyrics: the Lyrics tab, Position card: Size reads "1.00×" and the Floating Distance "10.7 blocks"
#   on the branch (the mod's texts are English in Pirate Speak); main "1,00×" and "10,7 blocks".
# - review171-pirate-timing: the settings searched for the Timing row (Timing set to +0.25 s): "+0.25 s" on the branch,
#   "+0,25 s" on main.
# - review171-pirate-key: the message above the hotbar after one press of Lyrics are late: a decimal point on the
#   branch, a comma on main.
# - review171-lolcat-bar, review171-klingon-bar: the clock: "9:07 PM" style on the branch, 24 hours on main.
# - review171-de-bar, review171-de-lyrics: German, for comparison: the same on both (24 hours, "1,00×", "10,7 Blöcke").
# Run it, and with -f mod_ref=main for the old code (the script comes from --ref):
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/review171 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/review171.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/review171 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/review171.txt

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
look 0 -20
guiscale 3
sleep 8
set placement FLOATING
set syncOffsetMs 250
bind skylyrics.lyrics_late period
bind skylyrics.lyrics_early comma
sleep 1

shot review171-en-bar

lang en_pt
sleep 15
shot review171-pirate-bar
gui 0
sleep 2
shot review171-pirate-lyrics
search Timing
sleep 2
shot review171-pirate-timing
close
sleep 1
hold skylyrics.lyrics_late 60
sleep 0.6
shot review171-pirate-key
hold skylyrics.lyrics_early 60
sleep 3

lang lol_us
sleep 15
shot review171-lolcat-bar

lang tlh_aa
sleep 15
shot review171-klingon-bar

lang de_de
sleep 15
shot review171-de-bar
gui 0
sleep 2
shot review171-de-lyrics
close
sleep 1

lang en_us
sleep 15
